repos.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
repos.summary_zh: ECC 是一个 AI 智能体性能优化系统，专为 Claude Code、Cursor、GitHub Copilot 等 AI 编程助手设计。系统提供技能管理、内存优化、安全扫描和研究优先开发框架，支持跨 harness 架构。从 Anthropic hackathon 胜出，经过 10+ 个月实战验证，支持 12+ 语言生态，可显著提升 AI 编程效率和质量。
repos.summary_en: ECC is a production-ready AI agent harness performance optimization system designed for Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and other AI coding assistants. It provides comprehensive capabilities including skills management, instincts, memory optimization, continuous learning, security scanning, and research-first development framework. Winner of Anthropic hackathon, battle-tested over 10+ months across 12+ language ecosystems with cross-harness architecture, dramatically improving AI coding efficiency and code quality.

repos.description: Turn any codebase, with its docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs, into a queryable knowledge graph. A /graphify skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI: local deterministic AST parsing, every edge explained, no vector store.
repos.summary_zh: Graphify 将任意代码库（含文档、SQL、PDF、图像、视频）转化为可查询知识图谱，作为 Claude Code、Cursor 等 17+ AI 编码助手的 /graphify 技能。本地 tree-sitter AST 确定性解析 36+ 语言代码，无 LLM 且数据不离机；每个边标注 EXTRACTED/INFERRED 确保透明。输出交互式 graph.html、GRAPH_REPORT.md 和 graph.json，支持路径查询、社区检测（Leiden），非向量存储。适用于新项目理解、PR 审查、团队 onboarding，大幅降低 AI token 消耗。
repos.summary_en: Graphify turns any codebase—including code, docs, SQL, configs, PDFs, images, and videos—into a queryable knowledge graph. It installs as a /graphify skill for 17+ AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI. Code is parsed locally and deterministically via tree-sitter AST across 36+ languages with no LLM or data leaving the machine. Every edge is tagged EXTRACTED or INFERRED for auditability. It outputs interactive graph.html, a report, and graph.json for path queries, community detection, and concept exploration instead of vector stores or grepping. Ideal for onboarding, codebase navigation, PR reviews, and grounding AI responses with significant token savings.

repos.description: A collection of DESIGN.md files analysis by popular brand design systems. Drop one into your project and let coding agents generate a matching UI.
repos.summary_zh: 精选55+个知名网站的DESIGN.md设计系统文档，为AI编码代理提供纯文本规范以生成像素级完美UI。完整定义视觉主题、色彩、排版、组件样式及响应式行为，无需Figma或JSON等复杂工具，显著提升AI驱动前端开发的效率与一致性。
repos.summary_en: A curated collection of 55+ DESIGN.md files from popular websites, capturing complete design systems in plain text. Enables AI coding agents to generate pixel-perfect UIs by defining visual themes, colors, typography, components, and responsive behavior. Eliminates Figma exports or JSON schemas, streamlining AI-powered frontend development with LLM-friendly markdown format.

repos.description: Turn any idea, plan, or codebase into a beautiful interactive diagram. An agent skill for Claude Code, Codex, and more.
repos.summary_zh: Archify 是一款 AI 代理技能工具，能将自然语言描述转化为精美的架构图、工作流图、序列图、数据流图和生命周期图。生成自包含 HTML，支持暗/亮主题一键切换、剪贴板复制及最高 4 倍原生分辨率导出（PNG/JPEG/WebP/SVG）。SVG 支持系统主题偏好。集成 Claude 等平台，无需设计技能，通过聊天指令迭代优化。核心价值是提升技术文档和可视化效率，适用于系统架构、DevOps 流程及数据管道等场景。
repos.summary_en: Archify is an agent skill for AI tools like Claude that generates high-quality architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams from plain English text. It outputs self-contained HTML files featuring instant dark/light theme toggles, clipboard PNG copy, and native 4× resolution exports in PNG, JPEG, WebP, or SVG. SVGs include dual themes with media queries for automatic adaptation. Requiring no design expertise, it supports conversational refinements and is ideal for technical documentation, system design, CI/CD pipelines, and data engineering visualizations.

repos.description: Graphs that teach > graphs that impress. Turn any code into an interactive knowledge graph you can explore, search, and ask questions about. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI, and more.
repos.summary_zh: Understand Anything 通过多智能体流水线分析代码库，结合 Tree-sitter 结构解析与 LLM 语义理解，构建文件、函数、类及依赖的交互式知识图谱。支持结构视图与业务领域视图切换，提供语义搜索、引导游览、影响分析和多语言支持。兼容 Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot 等 AI 编码工具，帮助开发者快速掌握大型代码库架构与业务逻辑，加速 onboarding 与代码探索。
repos.summary_en: Understand Anything uses a multi-agent pipeline combining tree-sitter parsing and LLMs to turn any codebase into an interactive knowledge graph of files, functions, classes, and dependencies. It offers structural and business domain views, semantic search, guided tours, and impact analysis. Compatible with Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, and more, it helps developers quickly understand complex projects, aiding onboarding and AI-assisted coding.

repos.description: 3,000+ reusable AI agent skills for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Gemini CLI. AAS Core adds local catalog discovery, agent-owned selection and plan preview. CLI, MCP and plugins.
repos.summary_zh: Agentic Awesome Skills 是一个可安装的 GitHub 库，汇集 1936+ 个 agentic skills，专为 Claude Code、Cursor、Gemini CLI 等 AI 编码助手设计。提供 SKILL.md 结构化剧本、插件、捆绑包和工作流，支持编码、调试、测试、安全审查等任务。通过 npm 安装器实现多工具兼容，强化提示工程应用，提升 AI 代理上下文与输出质量，是社区驱动的 AI 开发自动化核心资源。
repos.summary_en: Agentic Awesome Skills is an installable GitHub library with 1,936+ reusable agentic skills for AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Cursor, and Gemini CLI. It delivers structured SKILL.md playbooks, plugins, bundles, and workflows for coding, debugging, testing, and security tasks. Featuring an npm installer and multi-tool compatibility, it strengthens prompt engineering to improve AI agent context and outputs, serving as a community hub for AI-assisted development automation.

repos.description: 坚持分享 GitHub 上高质量、有趣实用的开源技术教程、开发者工具、编程网站、技术资讯。A list cool, interesting projects of GitHub.
repos.summary_zh: GitHubDaily 是一个运营近十年的开源项目策展平台，累计分享超10000个高质量开源项目。通过GitHub仓库、公众号、微博等多渠道，系统化推荐技术教程、开发者工具与行业资讯，核心价值在于从海量项目中筛选高价值内容，并按AI工具、开发工具等维度结构化整理，助力开发者拓展技术视野与提升编程能力。
repos.summary_en: GitHubDaily is a decade-old open source curation platform that has shared over 10,000 high-quality projects. Through multiple channels including GitHub, WeChat, and Twitter, it systematically recommends technical tutorials, developer tools, and industry insights. Its core value lies in filtering high-value content from massive repositories and organizing it into structured categories like AI tools and development utilities, helping developers expand technical horizons and enhance programming skills.

repos.description: An open-source coding agent for your terminal, written in Rust. It works with any model, can split one task across several agents, and every line of it is yours to read.
repos.summary_zh: Codewhale 是一款开源终端 AI 编程智能体，基于 Rust 构建，支持任意大模型（云端或本地）。它能自主读取项目、编辑文件、执行命令并自我校验，提供交互式 TUI、无头模式及 PR 审查等多种运行方式，适用于自动化代码修复与开发者效率提升。
repos.summary_en: Codewhale is an open-source terminal-based AI coding agent built in Rust, supporting any LLM provider (hosted or local). It autonomously reads projects, edits files, runs commands, and self-verifies results. Offers interactive TUI, headless CI mode, and PR review for developer productivity.

repos.description: Keep your coding agent up to date with the latest web best practices
repos.summary_zh: Modern Web Guidance 是 Google Chrome 团队支持的 AI 编码代理技能，提供 SKILL.md 文件与 CLI 工具，将现代 Web 平台专家知识、最佳实践和 API 模式直接注入 AI 代理上下文。帮助代理采用高性能、可访问、安全的原生 API 替代过时方案，覆盖 102 项现代特性及 128 个真实用例，支持 Cursor、Claude 等工具集成，提升 Web 应用开发质量与效率。
repos.summary_en: Modern Web Guidance, supported by the Google Chrome team, is an agent skill (SKILL.md) with a CLI that injects web platform expertise, best practices, and modern API patterns into AI coding agents. It guides agents to use high-performance, accessible, and secure native APIs instead of legacy patterns, covering 102 modern features and 128 real-world use cases across UX, CSS, performance, accessibility, and built-in AI. It integrates with tools like Cursor, Claude, and Gemini for better web development.

repos.description: Let Claude Code, Codex or Cursor use your real Chrome, logged in as you. One prompt to set up. Open source, MIT.
repos.summary_zh: Browser Harness 是一个自愈式浏览器控制框架，通过 Chrome DevTools Protocol 直连真实浏览器，让 LLM 自主完成任意网页任务。其核心创新在于动态生成缺失的辅助代码并持续学习优化，每次运行都自我改进。提供可复用的领域技能系统，支持从 LinkedIn 营销到电商下单等复杂自动化场景，架构精简仅千行代码。
repos.summary_en: Browser Harness is a self-healing browser automation framework that connects LLMs directly to real browsers via Chrome DevTools Protocol. Its core innovation lies in dynamically generating missing helper code during execution and continuously learning from each run. The framework features a reusable domain skills system for complex tasks like LinkedIn outreach and e-commerce ordering. With a minimal architecture of ~1k lines, it enables autonomous web task completion without predefined scripts, representing a new paradigm in LLM-driven browser automation.

repos.description: Plan, run and supervise fleets of agents from task to merged PR. Desktop (macOS, Windows, Linux) + iPhone & Android apps.  Supports Claude Code, Codex & 35+ coding agents.
repos.summary_zh: Agent Orchestrator 是一款跨平台桌面应用，用于统一编排和监督多个编码 AI 智能体（支持 Claude Code、Codex 等 25+ 工具）。每个任务独立分配智能体、隔离工作区和 Git 分支，通过实时看板追踪 PR、CI 和评审全流程，实现从规划到合并的自动化协作开发。
repos.summary_en: Agent Orchestrator is a cross-platform desktop workspace for orchestrating and supervising teams of coding AI agents from planning to merge. It supports 25+ agent harnesses including Claude Code and Codex. Each task gets its own agent, isolated workspace, and dedicated Git branch. A live Kanban board tracks workers, pull requests, CI runs, and code reviews in real time. A local daemon monitors agent activity and source-control state, providing a unified project view instead of disconnected terminals and branches. It enables efficient parallel development across multiple coding agents.

repos.description: A small, fast container runtime for macOS, Windows and Linux with free Ngrok alternative
repos.summary_zh: Kiri 是一款用 Rust 编写的轻量级容器运行时，兼容 Docker CLI、Compose 与 buildx，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux。它通过单个小型 Linux 虚拟机运行容器，启动速度比 Docker Desktop 快约 80 倍，内存占用仅约 15 MB，并内置本地域名、HTTPS 证书、Kubernetes 集群及多语言界面，是 Docker Desktop 和 OrbStack 的高效替代方案。
repos.summary_en: Kiri is a lightweight container runtime written in Rust, compatible with Docker CLI, Compose, and buildx on macOS, Windows, and Linux. It runs containers in a single small Linux VM, starting about 80x faster than Docker Desktop with ~15 MB memory footprint. It offers local domains, HTTPS certificates, a one-command Kubernetes cluster, and a 38-language UI, serving as a fast alternative to Docker Desktop and OrbStack.

repos.description: Ultra-high-performance, secure, all-in-one acceleration engine for developer resources
repos.summary_zh: Xget 是面向开发者的超高性能、安全的一体化加速引擎，专为加速模型、数据集与软件包等资源获取而设计，支持多浏览器扩展与边缘平台部署，并可将资源直接转化为口播视频，无需时间线编辑，显著提升开发与内容创作效率。
repos.summary_en: Xget is an ultra-high-performance, secure, all-in-one acceleration engine for developer resources. It accelerates the retrieval of models, datasets, and packages, supports browser extensions and edge platform deployment, and can turn resources into talking-head videos without timeline editing, boosting development and content creation efficiency.

repos.description: DeepAudit：人人拥有的 AI 黑客战队，让漏洞挖掘触手可及。小白一键部署运行，自主协作审计 + 自动化沙箱 PoC 验证。支持 Ollama 私有部署 ，一键生成报告。支持中转站。​让安全不再昂贵，让审计不再复杂。
repos.summary_zh: DeepAudit 是国内首个开源的 AI 多智能体代码审计系统，通过自主协作审计和自动化沙箱 PoC 验证，大幅降低漏洞挖掘门槛。支持 Ollama 私有部署，提供一键式操作和可视化报告，已实战发现 49 个 CVE 漏洞。适用于企业安全自检、开源项目审计和安全研究，让专业级代码审计触手可及。
repos.summary_en: DeepAudit is China's first open-source AI multi-agent code auditing system that democratizes vulnerability discovery through autonomous collaborative auditing and automated sandbox PoC validation. Supporting Ollama private deployment with one-click operation and visual reporting, it has discovered 49 CVEs in production. Ideal for enterprise security self-checks, open-source project auditing, and security research.

repos.description: pierre’s open source code
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个来自PIERRE COMPUTER COMPANY的开源元仓库，作为公司开源项目的中央枢纽。该项目采用TypeScript技术栈，目前托管了两个核心开发者工具：Diffs（专业的代码差异分析平台）和Trees（先进的树形结构可视化软件）。作为官方开源门户，它提供统一的代码分发、技术文档和全球开发者支持服务，体现了现代软件企业对于开放协作、透明开发和社区驱动创新的核心理念。
repos.summary_en: This is an open-source meta-repository from PIERRE COMPUTER COMPANY, serving as a central hub for the organization's open-source initiatives and developer tools. Built with TypeScript, it currently hosts two core projects: Diffs (a sophisticated code diff analysis platform) and Trees (an advanced tree structure visualization software). As the company's official open-source portal, it provides unified code distribution, comprehensive documentation, and dedicated technical support channels for the global developer community, demonstrating modern software enterprises' commitment to open collaboration, transparent development practices, and community-driven innovation.

repos.description: 🏞️ PicX，免费、安全的一站式在线图片处理平台。
repos.summary_zh: PicX 是一款基于 GitHub API 的在线图床管理工具，无需下载安装即可使用。它支持拖拽上传、批量操作、图片压缩和水印处理，提供 Markdown/HTML 等多种链接格式。通过 GitHub OAuth 或 Token 认证，用户可将 GitHub 仓库作为免费图床，配合 jsDelivr 等 CDN 实现高速访问，是开发者和技术写作者的理想图片托管解决方案。
repos.summary_en: PicX is a GitHub API-based online image hosting management tool that requires no download or installation. It supports drag-and-drop upload, batch operations, image compression, and watermarking, providing multiple link formats like Markdown/HTML. Through GitHub OAuth or Token authentication, users can leverage GitHub repositories as free image hosts, combined with CDNs like jsDelivr for high-speed access, making it an ideal image hosting solution for developers and technical writers.

repos.description: Curated list of the best truly open-source AI projects, models, tools, and infrastructure. Daily updated.
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个全面收录高质量开源AI项目的精选列表，涵盖核心框架、基础模型、推理引擎、AI代理、RAG、MLOps等14大类别。为开发者提供从研究到生产落地的完整技术栈导航，助力快速发现与集成前沿开源AI工具，推动AI技术民主化。
repos.summary_en: A comprehensive curated list of high-quality truly open-source AI projects, models, tools, and infrastructure spanning 14 categories from core frameworks to production deployment. Covers the entire AI technology stack including foundation models, inference engines, agentic AI systems, RAG, MLOps, and AI safety tools. Serves as an essential developer resource for discovering, evaluating, and integrating cutting-edge open-source AI solutions, significantly lowering barriers to AI adoption and fostering innovation through open collaboration.

repos.description: Help AI coding agents write modern Go
repos.summary_zh: JetBrains/go-modern-guidelines 为 AI 编码代理提供 Go 现代编程指南。从 go.mod 自动检测项目 Go 版本，使用 1.0-1.27 最新特性（slices.Contains、cmp.Or、errors.AsType[T] 等）。规避训练数据滞后和频率偏见，生成简洁高效代码，减少后续维护。涵盖 modernize 分析器全部目标功能，适用于 Junie、Claude Code、Cursor 等代理。
repos.summary_en: JetBrains/go-modern-guidelines provides Go modern coding guidelines for AI coding agents. Automatically detects project Go version from go.mod and uses latest features from 1.0 to 1.27 (e.g., slices.Contains, cmp.Or, errors.AsType[T]). Avoids training data lag and frequency bias, generating clean and efficient code with minimal maintenance. Covers all targets of the modernize analyzer; integrates with Junie, Claude Code, Cursor and others.

repos.description: Curated list of AI-powered developer tools.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库系统性地整理了AI驱动的开发者工具生态，覆盖智能IDE、终端代理到自动化CI/CD的全链路场景。核心价值在于通过LLM增强代码生成、重构与调试效率，并引入多智能体编排和沙箱隔离技术实现安全自治。典型应用包括Cursor/Windsurf等AI-Native编辑器、PR审查机器人及数据库智能助手，是开发者迈向AI编程时代的导航地图。
repos.summary_en: This repository curates an ecosystem of AI-powered developer tools spanning intelligent IDEs, terminal agents, and automated CI/CD pipelines. It enhances coding efficiency through LLM-driven generation, refactoring, and debugging, while introducing multi-agent orchestration and sandboxing for secure autonomy. Key applications include AI-native editors like Cursor/Windsurf, PR review bots, and database assistants, serving as a roadmap for developers transitioning to AI-augmented programming.

repos.description: De-AI writing skill for any Agent Skills-compatible agent (77+ via the Skills CLI), with native plugins for Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, and Antigravity. Narrative-architecture repair for fiction, venue-matched rules for professional prose. Based on StoryScope (arXiv:2604.03136).
repos.summary_zh: sepia 是可移植的 Agent Skill，基于 StoryScope 研究，从叙事架构层消除 AI 写作痕迹。小说先修复因果与主题结构，再处理篇章与字句；专业文按场景（发版说明、PR、事故复盘等）匹配规则。支持 77+ 代理及 Claude Code、Codex、Grok 等原生插件，提供写、审、改、重写四种操作。
repos.summary_en: sepia is a portable Agent Skill that de-AIs writing at the architectural layer, based on StoryScope research. Fiction repairs narrative structure before style; professional prose applies venue-matched rules for release notes, PRs, postmortems and more. Works with 77+ agents via Skills CLI, plus native plugins for Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build and others, offering write, review, refactor and recreate operations.

repos.description: Stealth browser automation for AI agents over MCP and the Chrome DevTools Protocol: navigation, network hooks, DOM extraction, and pixel-accurate UI cloning.
repos.summary_zh: Stealth Browser MCP 是专为 MCP 兼容 AI 智能体打造的不可检测浏览器自动化框架。基于 nodriver 与 Chrome DevTools Protocol，能有效绕过 Cloudflare、Queue-It 等反爬系统。核心亮点包括像素完美 UI 元素克隆（提取完整 CSS/DOM/事件）、网络流量拦截与 AI 动态生成 Python 钩子实现实时修改。提供 97 个模块化工具，支持最小化部署与跨平台运行（Windows/macOS/Linux/Docker）。无缝集成 Claude、Cursor 等 MCP 客户端，通过自然语言聊天执行高级浏览器任务，适用于受保护网站的网页抓取、自动化测试与数据提取。
repos.summary_en: Stealth Browser MCP delivers undetectable browser automation for MCP-compatible AI agents. Powered by nodriver and Chrome DevTools Protocol, it bypasses Cloudflare, Queue-It, and other anti-bot systems. Highlights include pixel-accurate UI cloning with full CSS/DOM extraction, comprehensive network interception, and an AI-driven dynamic hook system for real-time traffic modification via generated Python functions. It features 97 modular tools with minimal/core modes, cross-platform support (Windows, macOS, Linux, Docker), and seamless integration with Claude, Cursor, and other MCP clients. Enables natural language control for stealth web scraping, automated testing, and interactions on protected sites.

repos.description: Give your AI agent access to your live Chrome session — works out of the box, connects to tabs you already have open
repos.summary_zh: 让AI智能体直接操控正在使用的Chrome浏览器，无需重新登录或启动新实例。通过Chrome原生调试协议建立持久连接，支持截图、DOM操作、网络监控等能力。相比Puppeteer方案，可访问已登录状态，稳定处理百个标签页，适合需要与真实浏览器环境交互的智能体场景。
repos.summary_en: Enables AI agents to directly control your live Chrome session without relogin or new instances. Establishes persistent connections via Chrome's native debugging protocol, supporting screenshots, DOM manipulation, and network monitoring. Unlike Puppeteer-based solutions, it accesses authenticated states and reliably handles 100+ tabs, ideal for agents interacting with real browser environments.

repos.description: Portable project memory across Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode, plus token accounting measured from harness transcripts. Local file I/O, no API calls, no telemetry.
repos.summary_zh: OpenWolf 是 Claude Code 的开源中间件，通过 6 个隐形 hook 脚本为其提供'第二大脑'。它构建项目文件索引、学习记忆和 token 账本，在读取文件前提供上下文信息，阻止重复读取，自动记录偏好与错误。实测可减少 80% token 消耗，平均节省 65.8%，且无需改变现有工作流。
repos.summary_en: OpenWolf is an open-source middleware that acts as a 'second brain' for Claude Code, delivering sharper context and dramatically reducing token usage. Through 6 invisible hook scripts, it builds project file indexes with token estimates, accumulates learning memory from corrections, and maintains a comprehensive token ledger. By providing file context before reads, blocking duplicate accesses within sessions, and auto-documenting preferences and mistakes, it achieves up to 80% token reduction (averaging 65.8% across 132+ real-world sessions) with zero workflow changes for developers.

repos.description: 专为已有 Giffgaff 和 Simyo 号码的用户设计的现代化 eSIM 管理工具集，支持将物理 SIM 卡转换为 eSIM、设备更换和二维码生成。(A modern set of eSIM management tools designed specifically for users who already have Giffgaff and Simyo numbers, offering support for converting physical SIM cards to eSIMs, device replacements, and QR code generation.)
repos.summary_zh: eSIM Tools 为 Giffgaff 和 Simyo 用户提供在线 eSIM 管理服务。支持物理 SIM 转 eSIM、设备更换和二维码生成，全自动化 1-2 分钟完成。数据本地处理保障隐私，支持 PWA 离线使用。技术亮点为原生 JS、OAuth 认证和跨平台访问。
repos.summary_en: eSIM Tools is a modern online eSIM management toolset designed for existing Giffgaff and Simyo users. It supports converting physical SIMs to eSIMs, device replacements, and QR code generation through fully automated processes that take only 1-2 minutes without customer support. All data is processed locally in the browser for privacy, with PWA support for offline use. Built with native JavaScript and no frameworks, it features OAuth 2.0 PKCE, SMS verification, and GraphQL integration. The tool is ideal for users switching devices or migrating to eSIM on compatible iOS and Android phones.

repos.description: Github Starred Repositories Manager
repos.summary_zh: Gitstars 是专为开发者设计的 GitHub 星标仓库管理工具。它解决了星标过多导致的查找难题，提供按主题/语言分类、README 预览和快速直达功能。内置的 Gitstars Ranking 每日更新 GitHub 星标 Top100 项目，支持按编程语言筛选，帮助开发者高效发现优质开源项目。支持 Vercel 一键部署，实现个人星标仓库的私有化智能管理。
repos.summary_en: Gitstars is a specialized GitHub starred repositories manager for developers. It addresses the challenge of finding repositories among numerous stars by offering categorization by topics/languages, README preview, and quick access. The built-in Gitstars Ranking updates daily with GitHub's top 100 starred projects across programming languages, enabling efficient discovery of quality open-source projects. One-click Vercel deployment enables private intelligent management of personal starred repositories.

repos.description: Portable AI code quality reviews for Codex, Cursor, Copilot and other coding agents: six Agent Skills for architecture, technical debt, tests and remediation.
repos.summary_zh: brooks-lint是一款基于《人月神话》等12本经典工程书籍的AI代码审查工具。它诊断代码中的6种衰退风险，输出带书籍引用、严重性标签和修复建议的结构化发现。支持PR审查、架构审计、技术债务评估、测试套件审查及全扫自动修复等6种模式。作为Claude Code插件和Codex CLI技能集成，提供一致、可追溯的代码质量评估。适用于软件开发团队提升可维护性、降低技术债务，超越传统linter和纯AI审查。
repos.summary_en: brooks-lint is an AI-powered code review tool grounded in twelve classic engineering books including The Mythical Man-Month and Refactoring. It diagnoses code across six decay risks such as Cognitive Overload and Change Propagation, producing structured findings with book citations, severity labels, and actionable remedies. Featuring six analysis modes including PR reviews, architecture audits, tech debt assessments, test suite reviews, and full-sweep auto-fix, it integrates as a Claude Code plugin and Codex CLI skill. This delivers consistent, traceable code quality insights superior to plain LLMs or traditional linters, ideal for software teams improving maintainability and reducing technical debt.

repos.description: 🤖 The largest directory for AI-ready documentation and tools implementing the proposed llms.txt standard
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个 llms.txt 标准的中央资源库，聚合了多种开发者工具与实现方案。通过标准化文档访问协议，指导 AI 模型精准理解项目文档，提升 AI 编程助手准确性与开发者体验。提供 Chrome 插件、VS Code 扩展、MCP 协议支持及 CLI 工具，覆盖主流开发环境，推动 LLM 与文档生态的互操作性。
repos.summary_en: The largest directory for the emerging llms.txt standard, curating production-ready implementations and developer tools across the ecosystem. It establishes a standardized protocol for how LLMs should access and interpret project documentation, significantly improving AI coding assistant accuracy and developer productivity. The hub provides Chrome extensions, VS Code plugins, Model Context Protocol integration, Raycast extensions, and CLI tools covering major development environments, fostering seamless interoperability between AI models and documentation ecosystems while setting clear boundaries for AI-content interaction.

repos.description: A Cursor skill that gives AI agents real UI component knowledge — best practices, layout patterns, and design-system conventions for 60+ interface components — so it generates production-grade UI instead of generic output.
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个 Cursor AI 技能，为 AI 编程注入 60+ UI 组件的专业设计知识，包括最佳实践、布局模式和设计系统规范。通过消除 AI 的随意猜测，它能自动生成符合现代 SaaS、企业级或创意风格的生产级前端代码，显著提升 UI 开发质量与效率。
repos.summary_en: This Cursor AI skill provides AI agents with deep expertise on 60+ UI components, covering accessibility standards, responsive layout patterns, and design system conventions meticulously curated from component.gallery. It eliminates generic output by delivering specific best practices, common layouts, and anti-patterns for each component, automatically generating production-grade interfaces in five style presets: Modern SaaS, Apple-level Minimal, Enterprise/Corporate, Creative/Portfolio, and Data Dashboard. The result is senior-designer-quality UI code that follows proven patterns without manual template assembly, significantly accelerating frontend development workflows.

repos.summary_zh: Oz Skills 是为 Warp AI 代理和 Oz 系统设计的可复用技能库，通过 Markdown 文件定义开发规范与工作流程。技能以 YAML 前置元数据 + 内容的形式存储于 `.agents/skills/` 目录，支持项目级和全局级自动发现加载。该仓库提供预制技能模板，实现 AI 代理的上下文感知能力，显著提升开发协作效率，支持社区贡献扩展。
repos.summary_en: Oz Skills is a curated collection of reusable Agent Skills for Warp AI agents and Oz systems, defining development conventions and workflows through Markdown files. Skills are stored in `.agents/skills/` directories with YAML frontmatter and markdown content, supporting automatic discovery at both project and global levels. This repository provides pre-built skill templates that enable context-aware AI assistance, significantly improving development collaboration efficiency while allowing community contributions.

repos.summary_zh: Shadcn Builder 是为 shadcn/ui 量身打造的可视化表单构建器，通过拖拽式操作和实时预览，让开发者无需编写代码即可创建美观、可访问的表单。工具直接生成生产就绪的 React + Tailwind CSS 代码，完美契合 shadcn/ui 组件体系，实现零配置快速上手，大幅提升前端开发效率。
repos.summary_en: Shadcn Builder is a powerful no-code form builder specifically designed for the shadcn/ui component library. It enables developers to visually create beautiful, accessible forms through drag-and-drop interface with live preview, then exports clean, production-ready React + Tailwind CSS code. With zero configuration required and seamless shadcn/ui integration, it dramatically accelerates frontend development while maintaining code quality and type safety.

repos.description: the best diff viewer ever made
repos.summary_zh: comview 是一款专为终端设计的现代化 diff 查看器，可美化渲染 unified diff 输出。深度集成 git 与 GitHub CLI，支持实时 watch 模式自动刷新。提供完整的 Vim 风格快捷键、注释系统、主题切换和文本对象操作，让代码审查无需离开终端即可获得类 GUI 的流畅体验，显著提升开发效率。
repos.summary_en: comview is a sophisticated terminal diff viewer that elegantly renders unified diffs with syntax highlighting and side-by-side view options. It deeply integrates with git and GitHub CLI, featuring a real-time watch mode for automatic updates. The tool provides complete Vim-style navigation, persistent comment storage in JSON format, customizable themes, and intuitive text object operations. Specifically designed for developers who live in the terminal, it eliminates the need for web-based tools by delivering a powerful, keyboard-driven code review experience that significantly enhances productivity and workflow efficiency.

repos.description: 一键从 GitHub 跳转到 CodeWiki & DeepWiki & Zread 的油猴脚本 |  A one-click Tampermonkey script for jumping from GitHub to CodeWiki & DeepWiki & Zread
repos.summary_zh: 该油猴脚本为 GitHub 仓库页面添加一键跳转至 CodeWiki、DeepWiki 和 Zread 的快捷入口，无缝集成原生 UI。核心价值在于打通代码托管平台与 AI 增强的代码知识图谱服务，显著提升开发者查阅开源项目时的理解效率，无需手动复制链接即可获取智能生成的代码文档与架构分析。
repos.summary_en: This Tampermonkey script adds one-click jump links to CodeWiki, DeepWiki, and Zread directly on GitHub repository pages. It seamlessly integrates with the native UI, bridging code hosting platforms with AI-powered code intelligence services. The tool dramatically improves developer productivity by enabling instant access to AI-generated documentation and architecture analysis without manual link copying.
